notes.title: Speed0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36889244/174a508bc66584c6dbf7e9c32a7fa47f11684d9e.gif[/img]

Our first major update addresses many of the concerns users have. We've added custom speeds, slowdown mode (vs speedup), and fixed performance issues. This update will release [b]March 21, 2021[/b].

If you would like to contribute to UI translation, please visit https://translation.handholding.io/ . 

[list]
[*]Custom speed support
[*]Slowdown support
[*]Added a toggle UI for speedup vs. slowdown
[*]Various bugfixes
[*]Implemented i18n language translation support
[/list]

notes.title: Speed0 Release
notes.content:
It’s here and it’s done! We’re excited to finally release the finished Speed0 app today, on September 28, 2020.

Creating this software together with you has been a long and rewarding adventure, and we're very happy with what it has grown into. What initially was a small but powerful tool has grown into an intuitive tool thanks to the feedback of the community - and given a successful launch, this won't be the end of the road.

Let’s celebrate this momentous occasion with our new trailer for launch and final feature list for Speed0 version 2.3.4:

[previewyoutube=XfMl0BirvWc;full][/previewyoutube]

Features

[list]
[*] Speed up gameplay animations, cutscenes and text.
[*] Complete Steam integration lists all of your Steam games.
[*] Fast search for locating your game.
[*] Add a custom game to the custom game list.
[*] Search by process name.
[*] Custom hotkeys for enabling and disabling speedup.
[*] Multiple speeds.
[*] Game art for identified Steam games.
[*] Integration for game developers
[*] API usage documentation for game developers
[/list]


If you are interested in Speed0, you may also want to look at Mimir Studio, for translating games:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425950
